dim_resolution.output: use as per-row filter via name.gender.bin (no materialized set)

filters.predicate: production_year > 2000 AND (title LIKE '%Freddy%' OR title LIKE '%Jason%' OR title LIKE 'Saw%')
subject_id IN cct1_ids AND status_id == cct2_id

join_order.notes: title LIKE is extremely selective (~500 movies); drive query from title and probe fact tables via movie_id offsets index
use movie_keyword offsets; check keyword_id ∈ k_ids (linear scan over small set)
use movie_info offsets; filter info_type_id==it1_id and info∈{Horror,Thriller}; capture info bytes for MIN(mi.info)
use movie_info_idx offsets; filter info_type_id==it2_id; capture info bytes for MIN(mi_idx.info)
for each writer-note row, lookup name.gender[pid-1]==m_code; capture name.{off,dat}[pid-1] for MIN(n.name)

data_structures.running_min: four std::string buffers (mi.info, mi_idx.info, n.name, t.title); update via lex compare
data_structures.title_filter: linear scan over title.{off,dat} with memmem (Freddy/Jason) and memcmp first-3 (Saw); production_year guard

parallelism.morsel: title row range (chunked scan of title.title.{off,dat}); each thread maintains local 4-MIN, merge at end
parallelism.notes: Title scan over 2.5M strings is the dominant cost; downstream per-surviving-mv work is tiny (~hundreds of mv).

aggregation: scalar_min_x4 (no GROUP BY; four running minima updated as candidate quadruples are emitted)
execution_notes: Drive from title — LIKE+year filter cuts 2.5M to ~hundreds of rows; everything else is cheap point-style probes.
For each surviving mv, evaluate probes in increasing fan-out: cc (small) -> mk -> mi -> mi_idx -> ci. Short-circuit as soon as any required probe yields zero matches.
MIN values can be updated incrementally; we do NOT need to materialize the cross product — emit candidates per (mv, writer_pid) once all required existence checks pass.
mi.info MIN: only update from rows passing the it1 + info∈{Horror,Thriller} filter (per-mv).
mi_idx.info MIN: only update from rows passing it2 filter (per-mv).
n.name MIN: update from name.{off,dat}[pid-1] for any (mv,ci-row) that survived note + gender checks AND mv passed all other existence checks.
t.title MIN: update from title.{off,dat}[mv-1] when mv passes all checks.
